security.overridesDescBase: For each filter: inherit (use global), force on, or force off. Per-host wins over global.
security.footnote: Overrides are stored in memory. A restart resets them to config defaults — persist changes via the Config editor to survive restarts.

honeypots.title: HONEYPOT PACKS — {{host}}
honeypots.description: Toggle individual packs for this host. Untouched packs follow the global setting from the Honeypots page.
challenge.title: CHALLENGE — {{host}}
challenge.description: Interactive verification (proof-of-work / CAPTCHA) for suspicious visitors. Toggle it per host and tune individual behaviours below.
challenge.masterDescSuffix: ). Disable to let traffic pass straight through to the upstream.
challenge.behavioursDescription: Fine-tune how the challenge behaves for this host. Untouched options follow the global defaults.
challenge.offNote: Challenge is currently off for this host — these settings are saved and take effect once you enable “Challenge this host” above.
challenge.opt.adaptive.label: Adaptive ladder
challenge.opt.adaptive.desc: Escalate difficulty and randomise the rung order based on live suspicion.
challenge.opt.argon2_pow.label: Argon2id proof-of-work
challenge.opt.argon2_pow.desc: Use memory-hard Argon2id instead of SHA-256 — stronger against GPU/ASIC solver farms.
challenge.opt.privacy_pass.label: Privacy Pass tokens
challenge.opt.privacy_pass.desc: Accept Privacy Pass tokens so verified clients pass silently without re-solving.
challenge.opt.chained_trust.label: Chained trust
challenge.opt.chained_trust.desc: A successfully cleared challenge grants a 24-hour bypass cookie.
challenge.opt.decoy_captcha.label: Decoy CAPTCHA
challenge.opt.decoy_captcha.desc: Show a fake CAPTCHA to very-high-suspicion clients to waste their solver budget.
challenge.opt.honeypot_fields.label: Honeypot form fields
challenge.opt.honeypot_fields.desc: Inject hidden honeypot fields into challenge forms to catch form-filling bots.
challenge.opt.varied_errors.label: Varied error pages
challenge.opt.varied_errors.desc: Serve varied block pages instead of a single static one (harder to fingerprint).
challenge.opt.trust_for_auth.label: Trust on auth routes
challenge.opt.trust_for_auth.desc: Allow trust progression on /login, /signup, /reset. Off = always re-challenge there.
challenge.opt.ja4_ua_consistency.label: JA4 ↔ User-Agent consistency
challenge.opt.ja4_ua_consistency.desc: Catches clients whose TLS fingerprint (JA4) doesn't match the browser their User-Agent claims to be.
challenge.opt.header_fingerprint.label: Header fingerprint
challenge.opt.header_fingerprint.desc: Catches bots by anomalies in header ordering, casing, and missing browser-typical headers.
challenge.opt.h2_fingerprint.label: HTTP/2 fingerprint
challenge.opt.h2_fingerprint.desc: Catches automated clients via their HTTP/2 SETTINGS and frame-priority fingerprint.
challenge.opt.datacenter_asn_challenge.d: Challenges traffic originating from hosting/cloud ASNs, where real browsers rarely live.
challenge.opt.headless_detection.label: Headless browser detection
challenge.opt.headless_detection.desc: Runs a JS probe that flags headless/automated browsers (Puppeteer, Playwright, Selenium).
challenge.opt.webgl_audio_fp.label: WebGL / Audio fingerprint
challenge.opt.webgl_audio_fp.desc: Probes WebGL and AudioContext fingerprints to detect spoofed or emulated rendering stacks.
challenge.opt.dom_timing_entropy.label: DOM timing entropy
challenge.opt.dom_timing_entropy.desc: Measures JS execution and DOM-timing entropy to tell real browsers from scripted ones.
challenge.opt.proof_of_click.label: Proof of click
challenge.opt.proof_of_click.desc: Requires a genuine user interaction (click/move) before passing — defeats no-input automation.
challenge.opt.reputation_difficulty.desc: Raises challenge difficulty for clients with poor IP / JA4 / ASN reputation.
challenge.opt.fail_to_xdp_deny.label: Fail to XDP deny
challenge.opt.fail_to_xdp_deny.desc: Clients that repeatedly fail the challenge are pushed into the kernel XDP deny-list (dropped pre-userspace).
challenge.opt.turnstile.label: Cloudflare Turnstile
challenge.opt.turnstile.desc: Use Cloudflare Turnstile as the challenge. Requires the Turnstile keys to be configured.
